one_line: Messaging platform whose Bot API lets bots send/receive messages, media, and updates programmatically over HTTP.
auth_notes: No OAuth. Auth is a bot token obtained from @BotFather by creating a bot. Token sent as a URL query param or Bearer token header. Bot creation is free and instant.
self_serve_notes: Anyone can create a bot free via @BotFather; no app registration, approval, or payment required.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: 150+ methods (messages, media, payments, games, inline queries, webhooks via getUpdates/long polling)
api_surface.webhook_note: setWebhook endpoint for push updates; long polling alternative via getUpdates

existing_mcp.note: No official Bot API MCP confirmed (core.telegram.org/bots/mcp returns 404). Community servers exist (e.g. mark3labs/mcp-telegram).

evidence.note: Fetched text is the full Bot API reference (479KB); MCP existence verified via curl (404 at official URL)

agent_notes: No real uncertainty. Token auth means no OAuth flow; easiest app in the batch.
